name: app-shell
title: AppShell
description: Central app composition surface for topbar, sidebar navigation, main content, inspector rail, and command menu integration.

meta.api: Exports AppShell plus root, topbar, sidebar, main, inspector, and command-surface parts. High-level AppShell accepts topbar, sidebar, main/children, inspector, commandMenu, and sidebarState slots.
meta.stateOwnership: Layout state remains UI/app-owned. Pair sidebarState with SidebarStore, route state with the app/router, command state with CommandMenu/CommandStore, and responsive decisions with useMediaQuery.
meta.accessibility: Uses header/topbar slot, aside landmarks for sidebar and inspector, and a main landmark. NavList owns native link/button navigation semantics, while CommandMenu owns its combobox/dialog-like command behavior through existing UI/Core composition.
meta.responsive: Mobile stacks topbar, main, sidebar, and inspector in document flow. Large screens use a three-column shell with an optional collapsed sidebar track and independently scrollable main/sidebar/inspector regions.
meta.customization: Slots are intentionally broad so apps can compose Topbar, NavList, SidebarStore triggers, CommandMenu, inspector panels, and router-aware content without AppShell owning routing or domain data.

parity.shadcn: Follows source-owned shell composition and editable classes while avoiding a hard dependency on any single router.
parity.dataDenseWorkspace: Covers the central composition surface required by developer consoles, admin control planes, and workspace examples: topbar, sidebar/nav, main content, inspector, and command integration.
parity.tanstack: Pairs with app-layer TanStack Store/Router/Hotkeys code through slots and state props while keeping Core independent from TanStack libraries.
parity.keystoneCore: Does not introduce Core app-shell APIs. It composes existing UI source and app state.
